REVIEW WORKTREES: every one stays registered (DEC-208); do not remove, deregister or prune. This session added review-262-8ba7290, review-262-dc37c02, review-264-83095f4, review-264-ced8e77, review-267-efee5e6 and review-267-71bdc7c, beside every earlier review-* worktree.

HOW WORK RUNS HERE (learned this session): each PR gets an Opus review by a leader-spawned reviewer; the leader relays the verdict verbatim; code folds get a delta review, and the verdict, the filed follow-ups and the completion go in ONE post-verdict tracker commit touching .quest/ only; merge with a bare gh pr merge N --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <full headRefOid read from gh pr view>, in its own call, after the three checks (Check, Docs, Tracker integrity) are green on that exact head; a push is its own Bash call (the guard refuses a composed push); promote by opening a dev to main PR so the checks run on the exact SHA, then git fetch origin and git push origin origin/dev:main alone, then read origin/main and origin/dev by ref. The guard hook refuses a shell variable in a path: use literal paths, mutate a source file for a control with the Edit tool after copying it to a literal scratchpad path, and restore by cp. The lore documentation profile and the implementation profile sit at their token budgets: a docs edit can push either over, and compacting wording fixes it (a markdown link URL costs tokens; step 8 of the install runbook now cites ADR 0018 and 0024 as plain text for that reason). A new error code or a scope change to a DEC-255 clause goes to the leader as an A/B for an opum-doc ruling. Use biome format --write on your own files only. The actor is ward-cli-worker, delegated-agent, accountable human jdnewhouse. Skills: opum-handoff, opum-sdlc.
